Keep scoping and both Survey renders byte-identical unless a ticket is about them (replays compare them, LIN-4369).
The Surveys get no area notes pointer: survey-place reads no shape reports, which feed the notes. Scoping cites its pointer in its final message; both share `AREA_NOTES_WHERE` (LIN-4346).

`lib/prompt-template-defs.js` and the budget test change in almost every merge: rebase, then re-measure. Its fixture passes no context (the empty-context branch), so dropping one can raise a ceiling while real renders shrink (LIN-4393).
The `## As asked` block's words have one owner, `lib/as-asked.js`: import its spellings, never retype the heading or end line (LIN-4362).

`lib/prompt-template-defs.js` cannot import what imports `lib/prompt-templates.js` (a cycle): shared words live in an import-free leaf, as `lib/prompts/leftover-words.js` (LIN-4376) and `lib/prompts/autopilot-precedence.js` (never restate a rank; LIN-4382).

Prompt words banning a kind of how do not hold it (LIN-4369's replay: closing one channel moved it to the next). Hold the shape in code or a test (`SIZE_RECORD_SHAPE`, `lib/size-of-move.js`, arm 3) or hold the reader's side (arm 4).
A stage lead's first sentence is the selector's purpose line: changing it means new router snapshots, `scripts/eval/meta-prompt.baseline.txt` and routing ceiling (LIN-4369).
`lib/prompts/autopilot-precedence.js`: check real rows reach a server guard before prompt text bypasses it (LIN-4349). A scoped run's Periodical is opt-in by goal: no tail, no flag (LIN-4415).

`lib/periodicals.js`: close-out merges a Periodical's PR and sets Done as for any task; give no Periodical its own merge rule: notes are prompt input (LIN-4390). The rule is retyped in five files; only a test links them.
Model facts come from the OpenRouter catalog: add no model list or rate (LIN-4358); tests seed `tests/unit/helpers/pinned-catalog.js`.

`lib/library.js` takes a shelf doc's summary by position (`firstParagraphAfterTitle`): a paper that opens with a figure keeps its alt text under 12 words, or the alt text becomes the summary; a rewritten first paragraph re-pins `tests/fixtures/library-doc-summaries.json` (LIN-4428).

A blind reader's limits are instructions, not access: with the repository checked out it can still see commit subjects (`git worktree add` prints the head's) and area notes. Both slipped, harmlessly, in the LIN-4436 pilot. Code hands a blind stage SHAs and PR URLs, never a PR body or commit log.

`lib/periodicals.js`: Stability defers to a repo's committed declaration of its measures and names none (LIN-4424): change Harbour's measures in `docs/reviews/stability-measures/README.md` and its script, never in the shared template; a test links the bullet's list to that README.

A new stage kind is a row in every table `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js` reads: add it, or list it there as out with the reason. A kind in `SPINE` (`lib/run-view.js`) also moves the run page's "n of N", the session and task-page goldens (`UPDATE_RENDER_SESSION_GOLDEN=1`, `UPDATE_RENDER_TASK_PAGE_GOLDEN=1`) and the E2E count pins; read the golden diff before accepting it (LIN-4437).

`formatCiGateCheck` (`lib/prompt-formatters.js`) renders in implementation, review and close-out: a rule for one stage gets its own formatter beside it. Prove the others unchanged by rendering every kind, fresh and fix round, at HEAD and on the branch, not by the budget test, whose ceilings are caps (LIN-4441).

**Repository:** JKershaw/LinearViewer (Harbour).

**What this is for.** The tightest tangle in Harbour is between LLM & prompts and Runs & dispatch: the links between the two areas grew from 32 one way and 50 the other to 38 and 55 over batch 1 (Seams run 12). On this side:

* the list of routes that code settles without asking a model is copied about nine times, and `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md` and `public/llms.txt` already describe it wrongly (Drift, row 154);
* the blind read's name and heading are retyped outside the file that defines them (Drift, row 151);
* batch 1 added rules to the prompts as text (the frozen prompt total rose about 21,000 bytes, to 378,915). John on that limit: "That limit is to push against lists if rules. Worth knowing, but not hard and fast.";
* LIN-4350 asks to fold the rules together into plainer, more general instructions.

The safety pass (A5, LIN-4400) found two themes here: merge and read-only limits that exist only in prompt text (LIN-1242, LIN-1273, LIN-3417), and tokens inside prompt text (LIN-1372, LIN-1395, LIN-1408). Both are part of A12 (LIN-4416). The area's note holds 26 Waiting entries.

**What we want.**

* Each rule has one home; the copies are gone, and the docs say what the code does.
* A limit that matters is held in code, not only in a prompt's words.
* Fewer rules are restated as lists in prompt text.
* The area's Waiting entries are settled, or each says why it can't be yet.
* Each piece finishes one move and names what it retired; piece sizes vary, leaning larger.
* The Runs & dispatch side of the seam is A13's.

**Done when**

* the cases above are settled, or John has ruled they can wait;
* the safety tickets named above are closed in code for that reason, or John has ruled they can wait;
* the area's Waiting entries are settled or say why not;
* the area reads better in a blind read after this work than before it, by more than an untouched area read at the same times.

**Every change names what it retires. Questions:** settle engineering questions yourself; only John's calls (product, money, authority, what to retire) go to him as rulings.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

fields.says: Piece 0: baseline area read, first and alone, before anything lands. The LIN-4453 kit (`docs/plans/survey/area-read.md`, same frozen reader prompt) run on `llm-and-prompts` and on the control area `front-end-pages`; this area has no baseline yet (LIN-4453 recorded Runs and the control only). Repeated after the last piece (piece 6), to measure "reads better in a blind read ... by more than an untouched area".

Piece 1 (behaviour A): one route list. `codeRouteOf` takes its order from one ordered `CODE_ROUTES` list; `skipLiveWait` still skips the first entry only; comments become a pointer to `CODE_ROUTES`. *Witness:* the route tests pass unchanged; a new test fails on a route without a prompt-trace name and pins `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md`, `docs/architecture/source-map.md` and the `blind-read` bullet in `public/llms.txt` (wrong at HEAD, "Sent by hand"). *Retires:* the hand-ordered chain and the comment copies; the Waiting entry on the four routes.

Piece 2 (behaviour B): the blind read's words have one home. Nothing outside `lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js` and the template registry types the kind `'blind-read'` in a predicate or the heading `## Blind read`. *Witness:* a source-scan test with a short allow-list of table keys; rendered prompts byte-identical (the piloted sentence is not re-worded). `COMPLETED` in `recommendation-blind-read.js` is left to LIN-4447's move 3. *Retires:* the leaf's untrue header claim; the second constant.

Piece 3 (behaviour C): one record per stage kind in an import-free leaf; `PROMPT_TEMPLATES`, `STAGE_LEADS`'s traits, `COMPLETION_SIGNALS`, `GROUNDING_BY_KIND`, `STAGE_LABELS` and the `route`/`writes` pins become views of it, deleted in the same piece. `SPINE`, `BUCKET_OF_KIND`, `FIRST_PASS_KINDS`, `OFF_SPINE_KINDS` stay (Runs'); byte ceilings stay in the budget test. *Witness:* every kind rendered with real context at HEAD and on the branch, byte-identical; the tables tests shrink; run-page goldens unchanged. *Retires:* those tables, the ~fourteen-tables Waiting entry (rewritten to name what stays) and the `llms.txt` catalogue's hand-copied bullets.

Piece 4 (behaviour D): a reading stage cannot write what it may not. The bootstrap token is stamped at mint with its stage's `writes` (and, for one-comment values, the named ticket); the exchange copies both to the working token; `requireWriteScope` (`routes/proxy.js`) enforces them. `none` refused on every write mount; `one-comment`/`blind-comment` one comment on the named ticket; `ticket-fields` labels, priority, state, project and comment; `work` and unstamped tokens as today; an unknown value fails closed. *Witnesses:* 403s per mount for each value; a test over the router's registered write routes; every mint path passes `writes`. Preamble prose unchanged: guard first, words after.

Piece 5 (behaviour E), only after piece 4 has landed: fewer rules as prompt lists. `ONE_COMMENT_MANDATE`, `NONE_MANDATE`, `BLIND_COMMENT_MANDATE` and `TICKET_FIELDS_MANDATE` shrink to what the stage is told about its token (merge sentences stay, ruled); in one batch with one re-pin, the docs-only notes-PR rule, the committed-tool rule and the first-match lookup each become one constant in `lib/prompts/leftover-words.js` (the piloted blind-read sentence stays). *Witness:* rendered bytes fall net; no retired phrase in a second template. LIN-4350 stays its own ticket.

Piece 6 (behaviour F): the Waiting entries. Every piece edits the entries it settles (the LIN-4414 rule); piece 6 settles the rest by the plan's table of the 25 entries (settled by pieces, small here, moves to Runs, needs John, safety finds to a ticket, stays with a reason), rewrites the Lessons the new structure replaces, and runs the closing area read. *Witness:* `tests/unit/area-notes.test.js` passes and the entry count falls from 25.

fields.says: The kit cannot be used fully unchanged: `docs/plans/survey/area-read.md` names Runs as the work area, posts to LIN-4447 under `@ 4b5001ddf` headings and writes the verdict as D = Δ(Runs) − Δ(control). The salt and N=14 carry over; the area, base, target ticket and verdict wording do not. Editing the kit breaks its blob pin for LIN-4462's after-read, so leave the file alone and put them in an adoption block in each report's header: area, base `5dcf5bcda` (origin/main, the #2424 merge), target LIN-4448, verdict mapping, the byte-imbalance limit, the full contamination list, `areas.json` blob `1dc2ba701` (no change to either sample), the LLM note blob `b6b4c726d` (25 Waiting entries). Order: fix the base at `5dcf5bcda` even if main moves, provided none of pieces 1–6 has landed; write the adoption block before running any reader; then four fresh passes.

The pairing is not balanced the way the kit claims. The kit chose N=14 for a 3.4% byte gap (Runs vs control); at `5dcf5bcda` the samples are 380,459 B for llm-and-prompts (14 of 91 files) and 206,545 B for front-end-pages (14 of 92), about 84% apart. `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` (120,531 B) and `lib/openrouter.js` (103,188 B) are 59% of the LLM sample, so K3/K4 will mostly score those two files; each pass takes about 395 KB inline (sample plus the 14,838 B note), and the noise guard (≥1.0 apart) is more likely to trip. Record it as a known limit in both reports and keep N. Upside: all three planned files (`openrouter`, `prompt-template-defs`, `recommendation-live-wait`) are in the sample, so unlike Runs this read sees the work.

The control has more contamination than the ticket says. Three of its 14 sample files changed between `4b5001ddf` and `5dcf5bcda`: `lib/render-proxy.js` (812d9adbb, #2424, as noted), and `lib/render-swipe.js` and `lib/render-task-page.js` from #2423 (LIN-4446), which the ticket does not mention; `render-task-page.js` is also one of LIN-4453's four tracked files. The control's note changed too: `front-end-pages.md` went from 6,404 B to 5,825 B (blob `ae9c007e1`), Waiting entries 14 to 12. Both reads sit at `5dcf5bcda`, so the pair holds; record all of it in both reports. This control read's M scores will not match LIN-4453's.

Open PRs at `5dcf5bcda`: #2427 (LIN-4455) and #2426 (LIN-4456) touch neither sample; I checked every open PR and none touches the 28 sample files. Record that in both reports, and write PRs as `#NNNN`, never full URLs: the kit warns that `landingPrUrls` would pull a PR URL into the landing.

Smaller traps: (1) "frozen prompt" in the done-when means the kit's reader prompt, not the parent's 378,915 B prompt budget. (2) The reader prompt's K2 examples are about Runs; Δ is still sound, but do not compare absolute scores across areas. (3) Commit the reports as `docs/plans/survey/area-read-reports/{llm-and-prompts,front-end-pages}-5dcf5bcda.md`. (4) If you also post them as comments, use the `## Area read:` heading, not `## Blind read` (422).
